recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-shot portrait of a male performer in a highly ornate, white rhinestone-studded stage suit with a yellow scarf, set against a solid black background. The composition features two distinct typographic styles in the upper corners: a heavy, 3D block sans-serif on the left and a fluid, retro script on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed toward the right-side script typography
Yellow scarf color-matched to the primary typographic fills
Bright white stage costume contrasting sharply against deep black negative space
Diagonal balance between the top-left block text and top-right script text
coreInvariants: High-key lighting on the subject's face and costume
Warm yellow and orange color palette for all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered mid-shot, subject occupies approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The performer's face and the microphone held near the mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the block text (top left), moves down to the performer's face, follows the microphone to the script text (top right).
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black space surrounding the head and shoulders to isolate the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and silver from the costume and stage lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow and golden-orange used for the scarf and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow accents against zero-saturation black and white.

letterConstructionRules: Block text uses ultra-bold, condensed proportions with a 45-degree isometric 3D extrusion.
Script text uses a consistent monoline weight with rounded terminals and a rising baseline.
Both styles utilize a thick, dark outline to separate them from the background.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Block letters feature a gradient fill from orange to yellow.
Script letters feature a double-stroke outline effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid geometric block forms and fluid organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the block text extrusion.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a male singer with dark hair in a white 1970s rhinestone jumpsuit and a bright yellow scarf, holding a microphone, against a solid black background. High-contrast stage lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D block title in the top left with a yellow-orange gradient. Add a slanted script subtitle in the top right in orange with a thick outline.

verificationChecks: Does the block text have a 3D isometric effect?
Is the script text slanted upwards?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D text does not overlap the singer's head.
Check that the script text is legible against the black.
Verify the rhinestone texture looks like physical embellishments.
Confirm the color harmony between text and scarf.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast stage portrait with split-corner retro typography using a warm-on-black color scheme.
